'''Yiyar''' was a small [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It owned the [[Yiyar Salvage Corporation]], located on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Others did not like Yiyar members due to their violent behavior. [[Yav Yiyar]] was a member of the clan.
